summary: Future Direction Engine verified end-to-end via 14 new pytest cases (test_future_direction.py) + 5 real-UI funnels against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with mock Razorpay. IT Employee (future_goal=AI Engineer) renders 'Your Future Career Direction: AI / Machine Learning Engineer' with AI/ML Engineer pinned #1 (92% match) and the AI-survival sections (Reality Check, AI Threat Assessment, Transition Opportunities, Salary Plan) all intact. Working Professional (desired_position=Product Manager) renders 'Your Future Career Direction: Product Manager'; with 'Director' the FD section is gracefully skipped and 'Film Director' never appears. Manager (target_role=Management Consultant) renders 'Your Future Career Direction: Management Consultant'; with 'VP' the FD section is skipped and report stays valid. Blank fields keep old behavior (no FD section). Dream-engine regression (test_dream_engine.py, 17 tests) still 100% pass. All 9 user types still produce valid PDFs. Total: 31 backend tests pass + 3 full UI funnels (IT/Pro/Manager) including mock pay → unlocked full report → PDF link present.
